Name: Omelette
Instructions: Chop the tomatoes, cook them in butter, add beaten eggs and cook until ready.

Name: Pasta with Tomato Sauce
Instructions: Boil the pasta. Cook onion, garlic and tomatoes in olive oil, then mix with pasta.

Name: Chicken Salad
Instructions: Cook the chicken thoroughly, chop the vegetables and mix everything together.

Name: Vegetable Soup
Instructions: Chop the vegetables and simmer in water until soft. Season with salt.

Name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
Instructions: Place cheese between bread slices and toast with butter until golden.

Name: Chicken and Rice
Instructions: Cook the rice. Cook the chicken thoroughly with chopped onion and serve together.

Name: Potato Pancakes
Instructions: Grate potatoes, mix with eggs, flour and salt, then fry in butter.

Name: Greek Salad
Instructions: Chop the vegetables, add feta cheese and olives, then drizzle with olive oil.

Name: Beef Stir-Fry
Instructions: Slice the beef and vegetables, stir-fry until the beef is fully cooked and add soy sauce.

Name: Scrambled Eggs
Instructions: Beat eggs with milk and salt, then cook gently in butter while stirring.
